node_purpose: Owner approved exactly one fresh Dell Q1 issuer-truth Specialist shadow after the R2 provider object-root schema repair. Reuse the existing Agent Server and S1 Evidence/S2 Finance tools; allow autonomous multi-turn tool choice followed by a source-linked workpaper or explicit typed stop. No R2 retry or resume.
input_scale_basis: The zero-provider replay of this same Q1 graph completed in three turns. Host request sizes were 14,503, 84,822 and 92,192 characters; model-visible projections were 12,643, 33,269 and 36,026 characters. A 160,000-character per-turn ceiling leaves material headroom without silently trimming context.
required_outputs: one valid terminal Q1 Specialist workpaper or an explicit typed stop
a Dell issuer-truth thesis and mechanism linked to current Evidence and Finance references
material counterevidence, uncertainty and what-would-change conditions
typed open gaps when the approved local data plane cannot support a claim
schema_burden: Each provider response is one JSON object with the sole field action containing exactly one member of the existing four-action union: request Evidence, request Finance, submit workpaper, or request human review. The adapter unwraps it; existing host validation still rejects malformed actions, bad context, unissued references and unsupported authority promotion.
materiality_quality_risk: The main risk is a plausible Dell conclusion built from the wrong company, period, metric basis or a retrieval candidate that was never promoted to Evidence. The existing MCP and graph validators must reject those errors; a failure is preserved for review and cannot be relabeled as successful qualification.
comparable_run_evidence: The same Q1 zero-provider replay completed in three turns with real local MCP. R2 reached its first DeepSeek POST with 12,643 semantic input characters but received HTTP 400 because the top-level RootModel union was not an object; no accepted turn or tool action occurred. Fix 0c798101d7a14ff2b228fbc5c52e740ff20e60ae replaces only the provider object envelope and passed 67 targeted offline tests, including actual ChatDeepSeek/OpenAI SDK serialization and parsing through httpx.MockTransport. This is not live acceptance or independent review evidence.
reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro with thinking disabled, temperature 0.0 and one structured action per turn. The Specialist remains agentic across turns: it sees validated tool observations, decides whether more evidence or finance facts are needed, and chooses when to submit or stop.
cost_and_latency_estimate: Expected completion is three to five model turns. The inherited bounded planning estimate is at most about USD 0.35 for the expected path and about USD 2.01 for the absolute eight-turn anomaly envelope. Actual provider usage is authoritative, cost does not truncate required Q1 work, each turn may take up to 240 seconds, and eight turns is an anomaly stop rather than a target.
